description.narrative: The Forum on Microbial Threats generates independent and authoritative discourse on prevention, detection, surveillance, and responses to emerging and reemerging infectious diseases. The Forum covers topics related to emerging infectious diseases including Ebola, COVID-19, TB, vaccines, diagnostics, One Health, and many others.
